emma: FRA customs flagged AWB XZ-44-202. infra says EU pool will be short if delayed. vendor, options? split/air/reroute?
vendor-logistics: option A: split 8 units air (48h) + rest sea (+7d) at +$1.5k/unit. option B: full sea (+9d) with 50% credit on depot standby. need PO.
ops-lead: depot can stage up to 10 units Tue-Wed but we need serials within 72h or units go to quarantine.
procurement: we can approve air premium for up to 8 units. beyond that need stepped discounts. can you quote 8/16/24?
vendor-logistics: quick brackets: 8 air = +$12k; 16 air = +$22k; 24 air = +$32k (includes handling).
leo: ops note: if manifest missing we'll use temp IDs and reconcile (~1.5PD). quarantine triggers at 72h.
emma: vendor, can you absorb depot standby up to $4k if we commit to split?
vendor-logistics: we can absorb standby up to $4k if booking confirmed in 90min and photos/invoice provided within 48h.
procurement: OK to go with split 8 air now + sea for rest if vendor confirms standby cap and RMA pickup <=5bd.
vendor-logistics: confirmed RMA pickup SLA 5bd and standby cap $4k. booking air leg now, will post AWB in thread.
ops-lead: please CC depot photo checklist and provisional manifest (temp IDs if needed). we'll prep a short recon runbook.
emma: thanks all. finances/PO amendment will follow. :thumbsup:
